ResourceHeader.Description: The ACE Real-Time Shock Page displays automated detections and shock parameter solutions for interplanetary shocks observed by NASA's Advanced Composition Explorer (ACE) spacecraft. This catalog maintained by the ACE Science Center at Caltech that logs every potential interplanetary shock wave detected in real-time solar wind data from ACE/SWEPAM and ACE/MAG instruments. It includes: • Shock ID: Lists detected events by date and time. • Shock Type (F/R): Indicates forward (F) or reverse shock classification. • Automated Solutions & Uncertainties: Provides calculated shock parameters (such as shock normal, speed, angles, ratios, Mach number, and estimated ejecta speeds) along with uncertainty values. • Quality Flags: Notes when a solution is not nominal or lists reasons for inadequate solutions, such as low Mach numbers or high uncertainty in wind velocity or proton (H+) density.
